The '''D-4 mobile defense platform''' from [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] was a heavy landspeeder designed for urban combat, though it was also used as an emergency response vehicle. The D-4 could carry a squad of troopers into a battle zone, offering protection and light fire support. The vehicle was heavily shielded, and a shield projector system that could extend its shields out to create a defensive perimeter.<ref name="Keeping the Peace">''[[Keeping the Peace]]''</ref>

Incom also repurposed the base D-4 speeder into the [[D-4s projection platform]].<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />
